t: Preserve sub-second precision when serializing ``unixTimestamp`` request parameters. Timestamps with a fractional component are now sent as a fractional value (e.g. ``1704110400.123456``) instead of being truncated to whole seconds (fixes `#3255 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/3255>`__). Whole-second timestamps are unchanged. The previous behavior can be restored by setting ``timestamp_precision`` to ``'legacy'`` in a ``creating-serializer`` event handler.
Fixes a bug where instances of decimal.Decimal were unable to be passed into JSON serialization
rest-json serialization defaults aligned across AWS SDKs
Fixes `#1557 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/1557>`__. Fixed a regression in serialization where request bodies would be improperly encoded.
Account for boolean in query string serialization
